description: ResilienceAI predicts and prevents burnout before it happens. Using short weekly pulse surveys and AI-driven analysis, our MVP Neural Calm delivers predictive resilience scores, early risk detection, and personalized nudges for managers.
problem_statement: Burnout and disengagement cost companies over $322B/year globally. Most HR tools react too late — they measure satisfaction after problems surface. Predicts and prevents burnout before it happens. Using short weekly pulse surveys and AI-driven analysis, our MVP Neural Calm delivers predictive resilience scores, early risk detection, and personalized nudges for managers.
